title: Flexport (YC W14) Is Hiring in Indonesia, India, and Thailand
summary: Flexport, a Y Combinator-backed logistics and freight forwarding company from Winter 2014, is actively recruiting talent in Southeast Asia and South Asia, specifically in Indonesia, India, and Thailand to support their global supply chain operations.
problem_solved: Helps companies efficiently manage global shipping and logistics by connecting shippers with carriers through technology-driven solutions.
why_valuable: Provides employment opportunities in tech-forward logistics roles across emerging markets while advancing digital transformation in global trade.
